import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    
    static class ModInt {
        int value;
        
        ModInt(long v) {
            v %= MOD;
            if (v < 0) v += MOD;
            value = (int)v;
        }
        
        ModInt(int v) {
            value = v % MOD;
            if (value < 0) value += MOD;
        }
        
        static int mod_inverse(int a, int m) {
            int g = m, r = a, x = 0, y = 1;
            while (r != 0) {
                int q = g / r;
                g %= r;
                int temp = g; g = r; r = temp;
                x -= q * y;
                temp = x; x = y; y = temp;
            }
            return x < 0 ? x + m : x;
        }
        
        static int mod_inverse(int a) {
            return mod_inverse(a, MOD);
        }
        
        int toInt() {
            return value;
        }
        
        ModInt add(ModInt other) {
            value += other.value;
            if (value >= MOD) value -= MOD;
            return this;
        }
        
        ModInt subtract(ModInt other) {
            value -= other.value;
            if (value < 0) value += MOD;
            return this;
        }
        
        static long fast_mod(long x) {
            return x % MOD;
        }
        
        ModInt multiply(ModInt other) {
            value = (int)fast_mod((long)value * other.value);
            return this;
        }
        
        ModInt divide(ModInt other) {
            return multiply(other.inverse());
        }
        
        ModInt addSelf(ModInt other) {
            return add(other);
        }
        
        ModInt subtractSelf(ModInt other) {
            return subtract(other);
        }
        
        ModInt multiplySelf(ModInt other) {
            return multiply(other);
        }
        
        ModInt divideSelf(ModInt other) {
            return divide(other);
        }
        
        ModInt increment() {
            value = (value == MOD - 1) ? 0 : value + 1;
            return this;
        }
        
        ModInt decrement() {
            value = (value == 0) ? MOD - 1 : value - 1;
            return this;
        }
        
        ModInt negate() {
            return value != 0 ? new ModInt(MOD - value) : new ModInt(0);
        }
        
        boolean equals(ModInt other) {
            return value == other.value;
        }
        
        ModInt inverse() {
            return new ModInt(mod_inverse(value));
        }
        
        ModInt power(long exp) {
            ModInt base = new ModInt(value);
            ModInt result = new ModInt(1);
            while (exp > 0) {
                if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                    result.multiply(base);
                }
                base.multiply(base);
                exp >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }
    }
    
    static final int MAX_N = 7;
    static int n;
    static ModInt[][] probabilities = new ModInt[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                int p = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                probabilities[i][j] = new ModInt(p).divide(new ModInt(100));
            }
        }
        
        List<List<Integer>> masksByPopulation = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAX_N; ++i) {
            masksByPopulation.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        
        int[] indexMap = new int[1 << n];
        Arrays.fill(indexMap, -1);
        
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
            int popcount = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            indexMap[mask] = masksByPopulation.get(popcount).size();
            masksByPopulation.get(popcount).add(mask);
        }
        
        Map<Long, ModInt> currentStates = new HashMap<>();
        currentStates.put(1L << indexMap[0], new ModInt(1));
        
        for (int step = 0; step < n; ++step) {
            Map<Long, ModInt> nextStates = new HashMap<>();
            
            for (int currentMask = 0; currentMask < (1 << n); ++currentMask) {
                ModInt product = new ModInt(1);
                for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                    if (((currentMask >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                        product = product.multiply(probabilities[step][j]);
                    } else {
                        ModInt complement = new ModInt(1).subtract(probabilities[step][j]);
                        product = product.add(complement);
                    }
                }
                
                for (Map.Entry<Long, ModInt> entry : currentStates.entrySet()) {
                    long state = entry.getKey();
                    ModInt prob = entry.getValue();
                    
                    long newState = 0;
                    
                    for (int mask : masksByPopulation.get(step)) {
                        if (((state >> indexMap[mask]) & 1) == 1) {
                            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                                if ((((currentMask >> i) & 1) == 1) && (((mask >> i) & 1) == 0)) {
                                    newState |= 1L << indexMap[mask | (1 << i)];
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    
                    ModInt contribution = prob.multiply(product);
                    nextStates.put(newState, addOrCreate(nextStates, newState, contribution));
                }
            }
            
            currentStates = nextStates;
        }
        
        ModInt result = new ModInt(0);
        long fullSet = (1L << n) - 1;
        
        for (Map.Entry<Long, ModInt> entry : currentStates.entrySet()) {
            if (((entry.getKey() >> indexMap[(int)fullSet]) & 1) == 1) {
                result = result.add(entry.getValue());
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(result.toInt());
    }
    
    static ModInt addOrCreate(Map<Long, ModInt> map, long key, ModInt value) {
        if (map.containsKey(key)) {
            map.get(key).add(value);
            return map.get(key);
        } else {
            ModInt newValue = new ModInt(value.value);
            map.put(key, newValue);
            return newValue;
        }
    }
}
